caseStudies.headline: A $35/day lead engine projected at 84 enquiries per month, $12.50 CPL
caseStudies.summary:
Worked on Meta Ads lead-generation campaigns for Wishart Jewellers, an international jewellery retailer serving customers in Australia. The primary focus was promoting customised and personalised jewellery, helping potential customers explore designs that match their preferences and requirements.

The campaign strategy focused on reaching audiences interested in bespoke jewellery, engagement rings, diamond and gemstone designs, and personalised gifting. I worked with a $35/day campaign budget, using product-focused creatives and Meta Instant Forms to encourage relevant enquiries.
